name: Shy Maiden
body:
Aura strong transmutation; CL 8th; Slot head; Price 20,000 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

This tattoo is most often rendered with the large image of a woman inked onto the upper back of the user.

The tattoo’s owner gains the following:

Continual: +2 enhancement bonus to Charisma
At will: Assume the form of any Small or Medium woman (as alter self.)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft Wondrous Tattoo, alter self, eagle’s splendor; Cost 10,000 gp.
